description: The figure contains three separate pie charts summarizing category distributions for different reasoning types in the R2I-Bench context: a “Categorical” chart with 4 slices, an “Approximate Number Generation” chart with 3 slices, and a “Disjunctive & Conjunctive” chart with 2 slices. In the Categorical pie, the slices are Universal Quantifiers (light gray-blue) at 29.07%, Limiter (light pink) at 27.91%, Negation (light orange) at 27.91%, and Existential Quantifiers (light green) at 15.12%, with percentage labels printed inside each slice. In the Approximate Number Generation pie, the slices are Approximate Quantities (pale cream) at 45.03%, Comparative Relationships (light blue) at 36.26%, and Absolute Absence (light lavender) at 18.71%, again with internal percentage labels. In the Disjunctive & Conjunctive pie, there are two nearly equal halves: Disjunctive (very light bluish-gray) at 49.51% and a second slice (light purple) labeled only by its percentage 50.49% (the text label appears obscured by a gray rectangle), with the percentages shown inside the slices. None of the charts display a separate legend, and no slices appear exploded or offset; the slices appear arranged around the circle without an explicitly indicated ordering scheme.
